authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

audit_focus.card: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn

value: No commander-independent All Will Be One/Red Terror loops (decisions L40).
No extra creatures that dilute noncreature density (decisions L37).
No mana-spent payoffs like Uncover the Moon-Letters (L35).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No compact win; the deck needs several spells after Saruman lands.
One removal spell on the Army resets most of the board.
Without Saruman the high-MV discount plan is just card quality.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Mana Drain, Counterspell, Swan Song, Deadly Rollick, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Feed the Swarm.
value.protection: Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat; ward {2} on Orcs and Goblins.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Saruman is the Army engine and gives Goblins and Orcs ward {2}.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native identity, but the only Spellbook combo in the list is Fall of Cair Andros + Blasphemous Act, which doesn't need him. He's a four-mana engine with no compact win; the source rejected commander-independent All Will Be One loops (decisions L40). Expect a mid Bracket 4 value/burn deck. M1 review (saruman-01..07) verifies the mana-value and copy rules and flags a documentation error about The Black Gate (saruman-07).
